page-construction.php.serv_sub: Four contract types, each with a clear scope, timeline and payment schedule.
page-construction.php.why_title: No Surprises Between Estimate and Handover
page-construction.php.why_sub: Most construction disputes in Nepal start with an unclear scope. We begin with a detailed BOQ, agree a payment schedule tied to milestones, and give you a weekly progress report with photos — so what you approved is what gets built.
page-construction.php.proc_sub: Six stages, each signed off before the next begins.

proc_cards.title: Consultation
proc_cards.text: We visit the site, understand your requirement and check what the bylaws allow.

proc_cards.title: Design
proc_cards.text: Architectural drawings and 3D views, revised until the layout works for you.

proc_cards.title: Estimation
proc_cards.text: Detailed BOQ and cost estimate with material specifications, item by item.

proc_cards.title: Approval
proc_cards.text: We prepare and follow up the municipal building permit on your behalf.

proc_cards.title: Construction
proc_cards.text: Structure, masonry, services and finishing, supervised by our site engineer.

proc_cards.title: Handover
proc_cards.text: Final inspection, snag list clearance, documents and keys — then a year of defect cover.
